briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and Google Gemini 3 push multi-agent capabilities amid escalating race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward agentic systems while regulatory pressure mounts on export controls and safety testing. Funding remains robust with major players securing compute partnerships.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with advanced multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic's Claude 4.1 shows gains in long-horizon planning; DeepSeek-V3.5 narrows performance gap at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates AI RMF with new red-teaming mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 2nm chips for AI accelerators; Microsoft and CoreWeave announce $4B data center expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models surpass closed frontier performance before 2027?
